41-BET. Unit 6 davomi — jadval, hayvon nomlari, tana qismlari.

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Barcha javoblar TO'G'RI:
- 3d jadvalining 16 katagi (DOLPHINS va PENGUINS) 40-betdagi matndan aynan chiqadi.
- 4a: 1=crocodile, 2=horse, 3=rooster, 4=monkey, 5=cat, 6=dog, 7=cow, 8=snake, 9=butterfly — to'qqiztasi ham suratlarga mos.
- 5: 1=beak, 2=feathers, 3=fur, 4=paws, 5=ears, 6=tail — oltita strelka joyi tekshirildi.
- 6: o'nta birikma ham 40-betdagi matndan olingan.

⚠ QUSh TURI ANIQ EMAS: 5-mashqdagi yuqoridagi qush 'an eagle' (burgut) deb javob berilgan, chunki mashq shuni kutadi. Lekin suratni kesib kattalashtirib ko'rdim — u aslida QIZIL DUMLI QARCHIG'AY (red-tailed hawk): dumi zangori-qizil, ko'kragi oqish-chipor, oyoqlari SARIQ va YALANG'OCh.

  ⚠ Farq: burgutning oyoqlari barmoqlarigacha pat bilan qoplangan; qarchig'aynikida esa yalang'och sariq oyoq bo'ladi. Suratdagi qush — qarchig'ay.

  ⚠ Mashq uchun javob 'an eagle' qoldirildi (kitob shuni kutadi), lekin bu qayd halollik uchun yozildi.

⚠ 4b — TASNIF: crocodile va snake = reptiles; butterfly = insects; rooster = birds; horse, monkey, cat, dog, cow = mammals. To'qqizta hayvonning hammasi tasniflandi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again, then copy and complete the table. Finally, talk about each animal.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing, jadvalni ko'chirib to'ldiring. So'ng har bir hayvon haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — MATNNI TARTIBGA SOLISH USULI.

Chap ustundagi 8 ta savol — hayvon haqida gapirishning tayyor rejasi:
  kind of animal     — qanday hayvon (sutemizuvchi / qush)
  unusual because    — nimasi g'ayrioddiy
  they can           — nima qila oladi
  they've got        — nimasi bor
  they weigh         — og'irligi
  they live          — qayerda yashaydi
  they eat           — nima yeydi
  they live for      — qancha yashaydi

BIRINCHI KATAK KITOBDA BERILGAN: Dolphins — mammals.

JADVALDAN GAP TUZISH:
  'Dolphins are mammals. They are unusual because ...'
Kitobdagi namuna: 'Dolphins are mammals. ...'

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Matnda: 'Dolphins are mammals.'

items.answer: they are not fish, but they live in water
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.'

items.answer: swim very well; easily learn how to play games
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can swim very well' va 'They can easily learn how to play games'.

items.answer: grey skin, a big smile, fins and a tail
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They've got grey skin and a big smile. They've also got fins and a tail.' Oyog'i YO'Q.

items.answer: from seventy to five hundred kilos
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.'

items.answer: in warm seas in many different parts of the world, in small groups
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'in warm seas in many different parts of the world' va 'in small groups'.
Matnda: 'they eat fish'.
Matnda: 'They live for about fifty years.'
Matnda: 'they are like other birds'. Tuxum qo'yadi, qanoti va pati bor.

items.answer: they are birds, but they can't fly
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'they are like other birds, but they can't fly!'

items.answer: swim very well, but they can't fly
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can swim very well, though.'

items.answer: small wings, very short legs, a short tail and thick feathers
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'small wings, very short legs and a short tail' + 'thick feathers'.
Matnda: 'They weigh about twenty kilos.'

items.answer: on the ice of Antarctica and in the sea around it, in big groups
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'on the ice of Antarctica and in the sea around it' va 'in big groups'.
Matnda: 'they eat fish'. Delfin bilan bir xil.
Matnda: 'They live for about twenty years.'

exercises.instructionEn: Which of these animals are reptiles/mammals/insects/birds?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GURUH:
  reptiles  — sudralib yuruvchilar (timsoh, ilon, kaltakesak)
              teri qattiq va tangachali, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals   — sutemizuvchilar (ot, maymun, mushuk, it, sigir)
              bola tug'adi, sut bilan boqadi, juni bor
  insects   — hasharotlar (kapalak, ari, chumoli)
              olti oyoq, ko'pincha qanot bor
  birds     — qushlar (xo'roz, burgut, to'tiqush)
              pat, qanot, tumshuq; tuxum qo'yadi

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: 'Crocodiles are reptiles.'
DIQQAT: gap KO'PLIKDA tuziladi — Crocodile'S are reptile'S'.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna: 'Crocodiles are reptiles.'
Ilon — sudralib yuruvchi. Timsoh bilan bir guruhda.

Kapalak — hasharot. Qanoti bor, lekin qush EMAS: pati yo'q, olti oyog'i bor.
'butterfly' → ko'plikda 'butterflies' (y → ies).
Xo'roz — qush. Pat, qanot va tumshug'i bor.
Ot bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.
'monkey' → ko'plikda 'monkeys' (unlidan keyin y → faqat -s).
Mushuk — sutemizuvchi, juni bor.
It — sutemizuvchi.
Sigir sut beradi — eng aniq sutemizuvchi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the list of words below, then label the parts of the animals' bodies. What are the names of these animals?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlarni o'qing, so'ng hayvonlar tanasi qismlarini belgilang. Bu hayvonlarning nomlari nima?
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI: paws, feathers, fur, tail, beak, ears

RASMDA UCHTA HAYVON BOR:
  Yuqorida — yirtqich qush (an eagle)
  O'rtada  — yo'lbars (a tiger)
  Pastda   — kenguru (a kangaroo)

KITOBDA BERILGAN YORLIQLAR:
  Qush:    sharp claws (o'tkir tirnoqlar), wings (qanotlar)
  Yo'lbars: whiskers (mo'ylovlar), black stripes (qora chiziqlar)
  Kenguru:  front legs (old oyoqlar), pouch (xalta),
            back legs (orqa oyoqlar), feet (panjalar)

DIQQAT — QAYSI HAYVONDA QAYSI SO'Z:
  beak, feathers — faqat QUSHDA
  fur, paws      — faqat SUTEMIZUVCHIDA
  tail, ears     — ko'p hayvonda

⚠ SURATDAGI QUSh — BURGUT EMAS:

  Mashq javobi 'an eagle' (burgut) deb
  kutiladi, lekin suratdagi qush aslida
  QIZIL DUMLI QARChIG'AY (a red-tailed
  hawk).

  ⚠ Qanday farqlanadi:
     BURGUT — oyoqlari barmoqlarigacha
        PAT bilan qoplangan
     QARChIG'AY — oyoqlari YALANG'OCh
        va SARIQ

  ⚠ Suratdagi qushning dumi zangori-qizil,
  ko'kragi oqish-chipor, oyoqlari sariq va
  yalang'och — ya'ni qarchig'ay.

  ⚠ Mashq uchun javob 'an eagle' qoladi,
  lekin haqiqatni bilib qo'ying.

items.whyUz: Strelka qushning boshi oldidagi tumshuqqa ko'rsatadi. 'a beak' — faqat qushda bo'ladi.
Strelka qushning tanasini qoplagan qismga ko'rsatadi. Doim ko'plikda: 'feathers'.
Strelka yo'lbarsning tanasini qoplagan qismga ko'rsatadi. 'fur' — sanalmaydigan ot, -s YO'Q.
Strelka yo'lbarsning old oyog'i uchiga ko'rsatadi. 'paws' — mushuksimonlar va itlarning panjasi.
Strelka kenguruning boshidagi uzun qismlarga ko'rsatadi.
Strelka kenguruning orqasidagi yo'g'on qismga ko'rsatadi. Kenguru u bilan tayanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: What are the names of these animals?

items.textEn: Yuqoridagi hayvon (tumshuq, patlar, qanotlar, o'tkir tirnoqlar):
items.whyUz: Burgut — yirtqich qush. Tumshug'i egri, tirnoqlari o'tkir.

items.textEn: O'rtadagi hayvon (jun, panjalar, mo'ylovlar, qora chiziqlar):
items.whyUz: Yo'lbars — qora chiziqlari bilan tanib olinadi.

items.textEn: Pastdagi hayvon (quloqlar, dum, xalta, orqa oyoqlar):
items.whyUz: Kenguru — xaltasi (pouch) bor yagona hayvon. Avstraliyada yashaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: lay, short, intelligent, keep, have, big, warm, look, parts, thick

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  1–6 — bo'shliqdan keyin OT bor → SIFAT yoki OT kerak
  7–10 — oldida 'to' bor → FE'L kerak

  intelligent, thick, short, big, warm — sifatlar
  parts — ot
  keep, look, lay, have — fe'llar

Barcha iboralar 40-betdagi ikki matndan olingan.

items.whyUz:
'intelligent animals' = aqlli hayvonlar.
Gap: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.

'thick feathers' = qalin patlar.
Gap: Penguins have got thick feathers.

'a short tail' = kalta dum.
Gap: Penguins have got a short tail.

'a big smile' = katta tabassum.
Gap: Dolphins have got a big smile.

'in warm seas' = iliq dengizlarda.
Gap: Dolphins live in warm seas.

'parts of the world' = dunyo qismlari.
Gap: Dolphins live in many different parts of the world.

'to keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlash uchun.
Gap: Penguins have got thick feathers to keep them warm.

'to look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq.
Gap: Penguins look funny when they walk.

'to lay eggs' = tuxum qo'ymoq.
Gap: Penguins lay eggs.

'to have babies' = bola tug'moq.
Gap: Dolphins have babies and feed them on milk.

wordFormation.introUz: 41-bet — hayvon nomlarining ko'pligi va tana qismlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligiga -s qo'shiladi, lekin ba'zilarida qoida boshqacha.
Bu so'zlar juft yoki ko'p bo'lgani uchun odatda -s bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Hayvonni turkumlash va tanasini tasvirlash qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: Crocodiles are reptiles. Butterflies are insects.
patterns.explanationUz:
Turkumlashda ikkala so'z ham KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.
'A crocodile is a reptile' ham to'g'ri, lekin kitob ko'plikni beradi.

patterns.formula: It has got / They have got + tana qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: A tiger has got fur, paws and whiskers.
patterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarsning juni, panjalari va mo'ylovlari bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega → HAS got. Ko'plik ega → HAVE got.

patterns.formula: sifat + ot (sifat DOIM ot oldida, -s OLMAYDI).
patterns.exampleEn: thick feathers, a short tail, a big smile, warm seas
patterns.exampleUz: qalin patlar, kalta dum, katta tabassum, iliq dengizlar
patterns.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida sifat o'zgarmaydi: 'thickS feathers' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: to keep them warm, to lay eggs, to have babies, to look funny
patterns.exampleUz: issiq saqlash uchun, tuxum qo'yish, bola tug'ish, kulgili ko'rinish
patterns.explanationUz: 'to' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — '-s' va '-ing' YO'Q.

patterns.formula: Jadvaldan nutq: kind → unusual → can → have got → weigh → live → eat → live for
patterns.exampleEn: Penguins are birds. They are unusual because they can't fly.
patterns.exampleUz: Pingvinlar — qushlar. Ular g'ayrioddiy, chunki ucha olmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Bu tartib har qanday hayvon haqida gapirish uchun tayyor reja.
